stem: A ball is thrown vertically upwards with a speed of 10 m/s from the top of a 200 m high tower. Another ball is thrown vertically downwards at the same speed simultaneously. The time difference between two ball reaching the ground?

assets.alt: Two balls at the top of a 200 m tower, one thrown up at 10 m/s and one thrown down. The upward ball comes back to the top after 2 s, moving at 10 m/s down; from there both move the same way to the ground.
